purpose: Synthetic bounded requirement-level assessment fixtures; not production assurance.

does_not_own: Interop Lab admission or promotion decision

fixtures.title: Conforming bounded synthetic named-agent propositions
fixtures.rationale: Only the listed propositions are assessed, not complete Enterprise or production conformance.

fixtures.title: Stale identity/name binding
fixtures.rationale: A stale binding cannot support a current name-assurance claim.

fixtures.title: Revoked operator or binding
fixtures.rationale: Revoked status contradicts current reliance; the revocation mechanism and safe suspension can still work.

fixtures.title: Missing freshness evidence
fixtures.rationale: Missing freshness prevents current reliance; fail-safe handling and status mechanism may still be demonstrated.

fixtures.title: Assurance overclaim
fixtures.rationale: Tier display contradicts achieved tier; missing transparency log separately remains indeterminate.

fixtures.title: Identity valid; authority unproven
fixtures.rationale: Identity/authority distinction and honest display can pass while action authority and step-up reliance remain unestablished.

falsification: If an expected outcome cannot be represented using existing ANAB requirement and evidence semantics, record the concrete gap before changing the normative core.
